answer: Delivery-commitment bond against bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits and promises one load to the vertex hub by close. Each load is a timber parcel, key-stamped with a fresh serial. It rests on the public ledge until an auditor weighs it within 3%; a late, light, or reused load burns the bond. First 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): a thousand fakes pay 3,042,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented load bears another key; honest pays 45 once.
